data.name: Faqih
data.long_meaning: A person who has mastered the Islamic law and jurisprudence. A Faqih is an Islamic legal expert and scholar who is well-versed in the interpretation and application of Islamic law.
data.spiritual_meaning: Representing deep knowledge and understanding, a Faqih is a beacon of wisdom and guidance for the Muslim community.

in_arabic.name: فقيھ
in_arabic.meaning: المتخصص في علوم الشريعة، والمعلم للفقه
in_arabic.long_meaning: الفقيح هو الشخص الذي يمتلك معرفة واختصاص في علوم الشريعة، ويتخصص في تدريس الفقه والقواعد الشرعية، ويقدم تفسيرات وبيانات حول أحكام الإسلام. يعد الفقيح من أهم الشخصيات في المجتمع الإسلامي، حيث يقوم بدور كبير في تعليم وتوجيه المسلمين على طریق الحق. يعتبر الفقيح مصدرًا ثريًا للفهم والتعلم، حيث يقدم تفسيرات دقيقة وبيانات متطورة حول أحكام الإسلام. في الإسلام، يعتبر الفقيح من المسؤولين عن تعليم وتدريس الفقه والقواعد الشرعية، ويقوم بدور هام في توجيه المسلمين على طریق الحق.

in_urdu.name: فقیه
in_urdu.meaning: المتخصص في علوم شرعة، اور ماہر فہرست
in_urdu.long_meaning: فقیه وہ شخص ہوتا ہے جو اسلام کے قوانین کے بارے میں پوری طرح سے جاننے والا ہوتا ہے اور اسے اپنے شاگردوں کو بھی سکھاتا ہے۔ فقہ کا علم حاصل کرنے والا شخص فقیه کہلاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: फ़क़ीह
in_hindi.long_meaning: फ़क़ीह वह व्यक्ति होता है जो शरीअ़त की जानकारी रखता है और शिक्षक के रूप में अपने छात्रों को फ़क़ीह का ज्ञान देता है।

in_english.name: Faqih
in_english.meaning: A scholar of Islamic jurisprudence and a teacher of Islamic law
in_english.long_meaning: A faqih is a scholar who specializes in Islamic jurisprudence and teaches Islamic law to his students. He is a knowledgeable and experienced individual who has in-depth understanding of Islamic laws and their applications. Faqih is a vital figure in the Muslim community, as he plays a key role in guiding Muslims on the right path in accordance with Islamic teachings. He is a valuable source of knowledge and learning, providing accurate and detailed explanations of Islamic laws and their principles.

data.cultural_impact: The title of Faqih holds great respect in Islamic society. It represents a deep understanding of Islamic law and a commitment to applying it in one's personal and communal life. Faqihs have historically played a crucial role in advising rulers and shaping legal and social norms.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the title Faqih is rooted in the belief that adhering to Islamic law brings one closer to God. A Faqih is not only an expert in Islamic law, but also a pious individual who strives to embody the principles of faith and righteousness in all aspects of life. The pursuit of knowledge and wisdom, as embodied by the Faqih, is a fundamental component of Islamic spirituality.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Ibn Babawayh al-Qumi, known as Shaykh al-Tusi, was a prominent twelfth-century Shia scholar who is considered the founder of the Ja'fari school of Islamic jurisprudence, also known as Ja'fari fiqh. He was titled 'Faqih al-Islam' (The Jurist of Islam) due to his exceptional knowledge and mastery of Islamic law.
historical_references.context: Twelfth century Shia scholar and founder of the Ja'fari school of Islamic jurisprudence, titled 'Faqih al-Islam'

historical_references.reference: Ibn Jurayj, an eighth-century scholar of Hadith and Fiqh, was a prominent figure in the development of the Maliki school of Islamic law. He was also known as 'Faqih Ibn Jurayj' due to his exceptional knowledge and mastery of Islamic law.
historical_references.context: Eighth-century scholar and prominent figure in the development of the Maliki school of Islamic law, titled 'Faqih Ibn Jurayj'

modern_usage.modern_context: In modern context, the term 'Faqih' refers to an Islamic legal scholar who is an expert in Islamic law and jurisprudence. A Faqih is a jurist who interprets and applies Islamic law in various contexts, including legal and judicial systems, academic and research institutions, and Islamic educational institutions.
